title: CSV export drops trailing newline on multi-line string cells
body:
**Steps to reproduce**
1. Create a chart whose query returns a column with values ending in a newline (e.g. concatenated multi-line text).
2. Export the chart to CSV.
3. Open the CSV and inspect the affected column.

**Expected behavior**
The trailing newline should be preserved (RFC 4180-style quoting).

**Actual behavior**
The final newline is silently stripped on rows that have only the newline in the cell. Repro hits `superset/utils/csv.py` in df_to_escaped_csv.

**Environment**
Superset 4.x

title: Off-by-one in /api/v1/chart pagination — last item skipped on page boundary
body:
**Steps to reproduce**
1. Have exactly 21 charts.
2. Request `GET /api/v1/chart/?q=(page:0,page_size:20)` — you get 20.
3. Request `GET /api/v1/chart/?q=(page:1,page_size:20)` — you get 0 instead of 1.

**Expected behavior**
Last page should contain the 21st chart.

**Actual behavior**
Likely an off-by-one in the offset calc in `superset/views/base_api.py` or the chart REST view.

title: Timezone bug — chart shows UTC dates for non-UTC users
body:
Charts using a `time_grain` rollup are rendering the bucket label in UTC even when the user's timezone preference is set to America/Los_Angeles. Reproduced on Time-series Line chart. Likely interaction between `superset/charts/data/query_context.py` and the React time formatter.

**Expected behavior**: bucket labels respect user timezone.
**Actual behavior**: always UTC.

title: Filter component state leaks across dashboard switches
body:
**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open Dashboard A, apply a filter on column `region = NORTH`.
2. Navigate to Dashboard B (no shared filter scope).
3. Observe: Dashboard B's filter component shows `region = NORTH` selected, even though Dashboard B has a different filter set.

Looks like a stale Redux/Zustand slice not being reset on dashboard mount. `superset-frontend/src/dashboard/components/nativeFilters/...`.

title: Race condition in async query results — duplicate row counts
body:
Intermittent: SQL Lab queries with `enable_async_query` sometimes return duplicate row counts in the result metadata when the Celery worker and the polling client race. Repro is flaky (~1 in 20 runs at concurrency 4). No clean repro script; happens under load.

This is hard — likely needs locking or idempotency in `superset/sql_lab.py` / `superset/queries/saved_queries`.

title: Missing aria-label on dashboard toolbar Refresh button
body:
Screen readers announce the dashboard toolbar Refresh button as just 'button' because the `aria-label` attribute is missing on the IconButton. File: `superset-frontend/src/dashboard/components/Header/HeaderActionsDropdown.tsx` or similar.

Low risk fix; should be a one-liner.

title: CSV export drops trailing newlines
body: When exporting to CSV, trailing newlines in cells are dropped. This is a near-duplicate of an earlier report and should be deduped automatically.
